title: humboltia cabellensis
intro: Humboltia cabellensis, commonly known as Wild Dagga, is a plant species native to South Africa, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The health benefits of Humboltia cabellensis include its ability to act as a natural sedative and anxiolytic, promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include camphor, bornyl acetate, and camphene, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties.
